title: Keto Malaysian Chicken Satay Skewers
description: A low-carb take on the popular Malaysian street food. Marinated chicken cooked to perfection on skewers.

ingredients.name: Chicken breast
ingredients.notes: Cut into small pieces for skewers

ingredients.name: Peanut butter (sugar-free)
ingredients.notes: Low-carb alternative to traditional satay peanut sauce

ingredients.name: Coconut cream
ingredients.notes: Low-carb alternative to traditional satay peanut sauce

ingredients.name: Keto-friendly skewers
ingredients.notes: Or use bamboo skewers for a more authentic look

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together coconut aminos, lime juice, garlic, ginger, and peanut butter until smooth.
Add chicken to the marinade and mix until coated.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve with coconut cream for dipping.
